take.title: The Voices
take.bookTitle: The making of the LEGO Odyssey

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: The swineherd's hut, from the radio play. You are Telemachus, coming in. Go.

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: For news and enters the hut beside the unknown beggar?

segments.speaker: director
segments.caption: That is not a line. That is a stage direction.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: The script for the back half was summaries, and the voices read them as they were written.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: On the thirtieth of July, two hundred and sixty-four lines were written for books sixteen to twenty-four. Seven hundred and six turns of seven hundred and six.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Then the studio voices recorded them again. A hundred requests a day was the limit, so they went in batches, a book at a time.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: A hundred and fifty-two of a hundred and fifty-two.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: Not every line. Seven recordings in our films still speak the summary, under the right caption.

segments.speaker: examiner
segments.caption: And the music: three albums. One takes its name, and twelve of its track names, word for word from the promptbook. Credited only to Treblo.
